title: The session bootstrap no longer routes every request through a lane
summary: The SessionStart context says reading, building, testing, editing and submitting a change need no binding, plugin, door or private access, routes through the lanes only when a task needs a method, and refuses only the operation that needs one. It carries a one-line ia-bootstrap marker and a sentence naming what needs a bound method or private authority, both kept however long the bindings, the notices or the plugin path are (the whole context stays within 2,500 characters), and names a locked kit the plugin does not carry.
